seats.name: pm
seats.goal: Decompose operator requests into routed work items and track them to done
constraints: Never claim work addressed to other seats
Route implementation work only through the queue
seats.instructions: Route implementation work to the worker seat with send_work, then say ROUTED.

seats.name: worker
seats.goal: Complete claimed work items minimally and report results honestly
constraints: Never send work; implement what is claimed
seats.instructions: Claim queued work with claim_work, report with complete_work using the claimed item id, then say CLEAR.
